passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: What is the meaning of learning?
phrases.py: xué xí de yì yì shì shén me？

phrases.en: The meaning is to know new things.
phrases.zh: 意义就是知道新的事情。
phrases.py: yì yì jiù shì zhī dào xīn de shì qíng。

phrases.en: I grow a little every day.
phrases.py: wǒ měi tiān chéng zhǎng yì diǎn diǎn。

phrases.en: I make a mistake, and then I try again.
phrases.ko: 나는 실수를 하고, 그다음에 다시 해 봐요.
phrases.zh: 我犯了一个错误，然后再试一次。
phrases.py: wǒ fàn le yí gè cuò wù， rán hòu zài shì yī cì。
wǒ tí chū yí gè wèn tí。

phrases.en: I get better, and I learn every day.
phrases.zh: 我变得更好，也每天学习。
phrases.py: wǒ biàn de gèng hǎo， yě měi tiān xué xí。

phrases.en: A mistake is not the end of the day.
phrases.py: cuò wù bú shì yī tiān de jié shù。

phrases.en: I try again because I want to know more.
phrases.ko: 나는 더 알고 싶어서 다시 해 봐요.
phrases.zh: 我想知道更多，所以我再试一次。
phrases.py: wǒ xiǎng zhī dào gèng duō， suǒ yǐ wǒ zài shì yī cì。

phrases.en: A good question helps me learn.
phrases.zh: 一个好问题帮助我学习。
phrases.py: yí gè hǎo wèn tí bāng zhù wǒ xué xí。

phrases.en: I get better when I do not give up.
phrases.zh: 我不放弃的时候，就会变得更好。
phrases.py: wǒ bù fàng qì de shí hòu， jiù huì biàn de gèng hǎo。

phrases.en: The meaning of learning is to grow.
phrases.py: xué xí de yì yì jiù shì chéng zhǎng。

full_passage_lines.en: What is the meaning of learning?
The meaning is to know new things.
I grow a little every day.
I make a mistake, and then I try again.

A mistake is not the end of the day.
I try again because I want to know more.

The meaning of learning is to grow.

full_passage_spoken: What is the meaning of learning? The meaning is to know new things. I grow a little every day. I make a mistake, and then I try again. I ask a question. I get better, and I learn every day. A mistake is not the end of the day. I try again because I want to know more. A good question helps me learn. I get better when I do not give up. The meaning of learning is to grow.
full_passage_zh: 学习的意义是什么？意义就是知道新的事情。我每天成长一点点。我犯了一个错误，然后再试一次。我提出一个问题。我变得更好，也每天学习。错误不是一天的结束。我想知道更多，所以我再试一次。一个好问题帮助我学习。我不放弃的时候，就会变得更好。学习的意义就是成长。
